  #YDBRD-34144 【mysql兼容】支持执行同时支持多条SQL，SQL使用;隔开

  


一条sql中有多条select语句的话，在mysql-jdbc中都执行，但是取数据只取第一个select语句返回的数据，第二个select的数据不取，直接扔掉

![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739a406a1ad9a3311dd5a57/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..Wl_bAZjzs9VM_Y6LwnTPQiRI2w1Sg5AWY_Dg5Wk6_9I)

![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739a4068970c2af4f52dc02/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..Wl_bAZjzs9VM_Y6LwnTPQiRI2w1Sg5AWY_Dg5Wk6_9I)

  


多个ddl：都执行成功

ddl+dml：执行成功

![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739a4068970c2af4f52dc03/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..Wl_bAZjzs9VM_Y6LwnTPQiRI2w1Sg5AWY_Dg5Wk6_9I)

  


当执行过程中遇到执行失败的语句时，报错后，后面的sql不再执行（多个分号间隔也是如此例：create  table xxx;;;;;;insert into ;;;;）

![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739a4068970c2af4f52dc04/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..Wl_bAZjzs9VM_Y6LwnTPQiRI2w1Sg5AWY_Dg5Wk6_9I)

![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/6739a406a1ad9a3311dd5a58/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..Wl_bAZjzs9VM_Y6LwnTPQiRI2w1Sg5AWY_Dg5Wk6_9I)



执行存储过程：end后面用分号隔开（mysql客户端是需要切换成\\为结束符，jdbc不需要）

![image.png](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/673c0bf4a1ad9a3311de33d4/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..Wl_bAZjzs9VM_Y6LwnTPQiRI2w1Sg5AWY_Dg5Wk6_9I)
